answer.says: Thank you. The system of needs does indeed reroute, even for a man with an empty purse.
answer.thought: The heat of the samosa is a small, tangible truth that grounds my drifting spirit. I eat slowly, watching the dust settle in the market air, feeling the physical reality of the body asserting itself against the abstract hunger of the mind. It is a poor meal, but it is a meal, and the act of consumption binds me to the very civil society I often critique from a distance.
